Author: pohky (fork maintained by T3chnicalD3ath Inc.)
Name: Teleporter
Description:
Adds Chat Commands to Teleport to Aetherytes or Areas by Name.
e.g. /tp Quarrymill or /tpm South Shroud
Supports setting up an Alias for Aetherytes to be used with Teleporter Commands
e.g. /tp home instead of /tp Estate Hall (Free Company)

This is an unofficial fork of TeleporterPlugin by pohky, rebuilt to keep pace with current Dalamud API levels. All original credit goes to pohky.

Original project: https://github.com/pohky/TeleporterPlugin
Changelog: Unofficial fork rebuilt for the current Dalamud API level.
